scope: Smoke driver, its scoped tests, actual retained fixtures, existing installer how-to contract, and installer evidence only

preauthorized_execution.launch_policy: Observed existing --yolo in Pij-spawned actual ps process evidence, corroborated by native session.permissions_changed. No flag, grant, or permission change introduced.
preauthorized_execution.temporal_policy: Require the latest native permission state strictly before tool.execution_start. A later grant cannot retroactively classify the invocation as preauthorized.
preauthorized_execution.execution_proof: Exactly one invocation after accepted incoming native event; exact pij_send tool and complete to/message arguments; matching success toolCallId, ordered native IDs, result ok:true and receipt msg_id; same durable jobs dedupe_key with exact source, recipient, body, payload msg_id, serial_key and delivery kind.
preauthorized_execution.screen_proof: Capture before observation and recheck before accepting completion. No active dialog may be accepted; unknown/mismatched modal fails, incomplete repaint waits boundedly. No send-keys on this branch.
preauthorized_execution.manual_path: Existing exact-dialog one-time human approval remains separate and strict.
preauthorized_execution.timing: Actual retained receipt screen plus subsequently read native events.jsonl and read-only SQLite row; not an atomic snapshot. Original durable payload including native_target_session retained without reconstruction.

exit_ghost.timing: Retained final measured frame and earlier failed staged frame are separate observations, not a backfilled atomic capture.

source_review.preauthorization_finding: Using latest permission over the whole log let a later grant authorize earlier execution

grade: Source/injected-IO and retained-screen/native-log/SQLite replay proof only. Existing local-provider probe provenance is not a fresh live run or real-provider inference. Native accepted, tool executed, model complete, and human approved remain distinct grades.
pm_next: Compose checkpoint, refresh frozen scoped driver, run scoped spawned/lifecycle probes, then canonical acceptance/full gates. No new live AC6/AC7, rollover or cold-resume acceptance claimed here.
